entities.summary: Herat, also known as the Emirate of Herat, and as the Principality of Herat, or Herat Khanate, was a state in Afghanistan from 1793 to 1863, and one of the three main khanates that existed in 19th century Afghanistan after the breakup of the Durrani Empire.
